title: Your First Weekend at Pomona College, Shared as Cards
description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented through Pomona’s campus landmarks, arts, and Claremont community spaces.

cards.title: Start at the College Gates
cards.subtitle: A first look at Pomona’s ceremonial entrance
cards.notes: Begin with a photo at the gates, then trace your route into campus. New students formally enter here during the documented Through the Gates orientation event.
cards.short_summary: A ceremonial starting point for new Sagehens.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona identifies Through the Gates at the College Gates as a traditional event where new students officially enter campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus landmark; follow current campus visitor guidance.

cards.title: Get your bearings on Marston Quad
cards.subtitle: The center of the Pomona campus
cards.notes: Use the quad as your campus reset point: notice the surrounding buildings, pick a direction for your next stop, and save the view for a return visit.
cards.short_summary: Pomona’s central quadrangle anchors the walking route.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona College’s catalog identifies Marston Quadrangle as the center of campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; access may be affected by college events.

cards.title: Read the current Walker Wall
cards.subtitle: Pomona’s recognized public-forum wall
cards.notes: Pause to see the wall’s current messages, then continue without adding anything yourself. Its changing painted surface makes it a useful snapshot of campus expression.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding campus wall used for public expression.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona’s timeline says generations of students have used Walker Wall as a public forum for painted messages.
cards.access_notes: Located by Walker Beach on the campus visitors’ map; view respectfully.

cards.title: Find Pegasus on Stover Walk
cards.subtitle: Stover Walk, north edge of Marston Quadrangle
cards.notes: Walk the east-west route along Marston Quad and look for the bronze Pegasus relief near College Avenue. It is a concrete waypoint before heading toward arts venues.
cards.short_summary: A named sculpture and historic campus walkway.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona documents Pegasus on Stover Walk near College Avenue and describes Stover Walk as a primary east-west campus axis.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor route and artwork shown on the campus map; keep to pedestrian paths.

cards.entity_name: Benton Museum of Art at Pomona College
cards.title: Step into the Benton Museum
cards.subtitle: Rotating exhibitions at the campus–Village edge
cards.notes: Check the museum’s current visit information, then spend time with one exhibition rather than rushing through. The building’s courtyard is part of the campus-facing setting.
cards.short_summary: A free public art stop with rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona states that all Benton Museum exhibitions are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current gallery hours and accessibility details before visiting.

cards.title: See Frary’s two murals
cards.subtitle: Prometheus and Genesis inside Frary
cards.notes: If you have appropriate dining-hall access, look up at the two documented murals while passing through. Treat the hall as an active dining space and follow posted rules.
cards.short_summary: A dining-hall stop with two significant murals.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona’s catalog identifies José Clemente Orozco’s Prometheus and Rico Lebrun’s Genesis as murals in Frary Dining Hall.
cards.access_notes: Dining-hall access and meal requirements may apply; verify current campus dining access.

cards.title: Check what’s on at Big Bridges
cards.subtitle: Concerts, lectures, and dance performances
cards.notes: Photograph the exterior, then check the current events calendar for an appropriate program. Attend only events whose posted entry requirements and timing work for you.
cards.short_summary: A landmark auditorium for major campus programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona describes Bridges Auditorium as a venue for convocations, concerts, lectures, and dance performances.
cards.access_notes: Event access, tickets, and hours vary; consult the current event listing.

cards.title: Learn where the campus farm is
cards.subtitle: A two-acre on-campus growing space
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate the farm, then look for approved ways to engage with its programming. Do not enter growing areas or handle animals unless invited.
cards.short_summary: A documented campus farm with orchard and chickens.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona describes its on-campus farm as a two-acre space with chickens, a fruit orchard, and a student-built biodome.
cards.access_notes: The farm is map-listed; participation and entry depend on current college programming.

cards.entity_name: The Claremont Colleges Ballroom Dance Company
cards.title: Look for a Ballroom Dance Company event
cards.subtitle: A recurring performance and formal-ball activity
cards.notes: Check campus listings for a public lesson, performance, or formal ball and follow the organizer’s attendance instructions. It is a structured way to try a social campus activity.
cards.short_summary: A documented Claremont Colleges dance activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona says The Claremont Colleges Ballroom Dance Company often presents performances and formal balls.
cards.access_notes: Schedules, locations, and participation requirements vary by event.

cards.title: Finish with Sunday market browsing
cards.subtitle: Harvard Avenue in Claremont Village
cards.notes: On Sunday morning, walk the market route on Harvard Avenue and browse produce, plants, and artisan stalls. Bring a payment method only if you intend to buy something.
cards.short_summary: A Sunday Claremont Village market with farm and artisan vendors.
cards.evidence_claim: The market’s official site lists Sunday hours of 8 a.m.–1 p.m., rain or shine, on Harvard Avenue between First Street and Bonita Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Sundays, 8 a.m.–1 p.m., rain or shine; Harvard Avenue between First Street and Bonita Avenue.
